# Approved local model notices

The model bytes are acquired into a service-managed cache and are not stored in
Git. Redistribution must retain this notice and the referenced bundled license.

- **SAM 2.1 Hiera Small** — `facebook/sam2.1-hiera-small` at
  `ee5bba1d82bb8749febdf90f45e84b687142ba03`; SAM 2 code at
  `2b90b9f5ceec907a1c18123530e92e794ad901a4`. Code and weights are
  Apache-2.0. Source: <https://huggingface.co/facebook/sam2.1-hiera-small>
  and <https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam2>.
- **SpeechBrain MetricGAN+ VoiceBank** — model revision
  `a196ce26b3bdace6fa1d819017584bdbcce462a8`; SpeechBrain 1.1.1 at
  `89ead74d163463d30c62329a09cfdb4c54f5abc1`. Model and runtime are
  Apache-2.0. This is a 16 kHz mono speech-enhancement model trained for the
  VoiceBank/DEMAND domain; no quality claim is made for arbitrary program
  audio. Source: <https://huggingface.co/speechbrain/metricgan-plus-voicebank>
  and <https://github.com/speechbrain/speechbrain>.
- **Open-Unmix UMX-HQ vocals** — UMX-HQ 1.0.1, Zenodo record 3370489,
  DOI `10.5281/zenodo.3370489`; Open-Unmix runtime at
  `814f144e34b2d1ed517eb605ce928dcb838abbed`. Code and model record are MIT.
  Source: <https://zenodo.org/records/3370489> and
  <https://github.com/sigsep/open-unmix-pytorch>.
- **Silero VAD 6.2.1** — `silero-vad` at
  `7e30209a3e901f9842f81b225f3e93d8199902b1`. Code and included ONNX weights
  are MIT. Source: <https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad>.

The upstream repositories contained no `NOTICE` file at the approved revisions
when these notices were recorded. Apache-2.0 terms are in `APACHE-2.0.txt`;
project-specific MIT terms are in `OPEN-UNMIX-MIT.txt` and `SILERO-MIT.txt`.
